short_description: The "training-wheels" antibody of the naive B cell — a single T/Y-shaped monomer of two heavy (δ) and two light chains, co-expressed with IgM on the surface of every mature naive B cell via a short transmembrane anchor as part of the B-cell receptor, and marked by the longest, most flexible hinge of any human immunoglobulin.
